title: The hasNext() method of an Iterator implementation should not call the next() method.
summary: The state of the iterator should not be changed inside the hasNext() method. The hasNext() method is not supposed to have any side effects. It is in the standard-library rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.2.0.

title: The next() method of an Iterator implementation should throw a NoSuchElementException when there are no more elements to return.
summary: It is in the standard-library rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.2.0.
